title: Sociaelo App
tagline: Sociaelo is an app that allows user to post content to everyone or to limited users
description: Sociaelo App is a decentralized social platform that combines Web3 technology with verifiable identity credentials. Built with React/TypeScript frontend and Bun backend, it enables users to create profiles, share posts, and interact socially while maintaining trusted identities through Self.xyz integration. The platform leverages multi-chain architecture: Celo network for identity verification (using Self.xyz's exclusive onchain infrastructure) and Filecoin EVM for subscription management. Users can access tiered features through decentralized subscriptions while enjoying the benefits of blockchain-based social networking with verifiable credentials and cross-chain wallet support.
how_its_made: This project uses Self.xyz to for uniquely identify user without disclosing their personal information. And we are using Filecoin's Lighthouse to store data on IPFS. This app allows users to create content that they can either make it available for everyone or they may limit the exposure to certain audience based on their gender, nationality and age
